coverage:
The dataset provides adequate lateral-motion coverage.
Median y span is 23.1 m in training, 24.3 m in validation, and 22.5 m in test. Median lateral travel is 67.1 m, 61.0 m, and 63.1 m.
An all-zero vy predictor has frame-weighted MAE 6.60, 6.47, and 6.59 m/s. Frames with |vy| ≥ 2 m/s are 67.6%, 66.9%, and 68.7% of each split.
The trainer's turning mask covers 86.1%, 86.4%, and 89.8% of frames, so it describes most of a clip.
The smallest train–validation Kolmogorov–Smirnov p-value across y span, vy scale, travel, signed displacement, |vy| fraction, x span, and vx scale is 0.32.
6 training clips, 3 validation clips, and 2 test clips stay inside the zero vy bin. Negative vx bins hold 0.29% of training frames, so the longitudinal label does not reverse.
